quests.desc: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First stop, pick-up the cake scented keycard from the floor of the cubicle. After that, make an attempt to go north. And then, unlock the cake scented gateway within the study. If you have unlocked the cake scented gateway, make an effort to travel east. After that, try to take a trip north. That done, take a trip west. Then, ensure that the cake scented gateway is open. After that, attempt to head south. Okay, and then, try to take a trip east. That done, take the passkey from the counter. And then, head north. And then, go west. If you can manage that, unlock the gateway. And then, open the gateway. After that, head west. After that, venture south. After that, venture south. Then, attempt to venture south. Then, attempt to take a trip south. Then, take the latchkey from the saucepan in the canteen. That's it!

objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First stop, move north. After that, try to travel east. After that, retrieve the passkey from the counter within the sauna. Then, try to travel north. Once you get through with that, make an effort to move west. And then, doublecheck that the gateway within the shower is unlocked with the passkey. After that, ensure that the gateway inside the shower is open. After that, try to venture west. Then, travel south. Then, make an attempt to travel south. After that, try to head south. Next, make an effort to go to the south. Then, take the latchkey from the saucepan. Alright, thanks!
